The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

titles.title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
titles.synopsis: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

titles.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
titles.synopsis: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

titles.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
titles.synopsis: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

titles.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
titles.synopsis: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

titles.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
titles.synopsis: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

titles.title: Infectious
titles.synopsis: During the Black Death, a hunted peasant named Frost fights to survive across plague-ravaged medieval England after a forbidden affair with a nobleman's daughter sparks betrayal, paranoia, and deadly pursuit.

titles.title: Lovesick
titles.synopsis: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

titles.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Stream the official podcast for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

titles.title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
titles.synopsis: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

titles.title: Last Reckoning
titles.synopsis: Despite his best efforts to stay away from crime while he's out on parole, Dan's life takes a turn when a duffel bag full of cash meant for gangsters is mistakenly placed in his trunk. With the help of his eccentric friend, he has to choose whether to return the money to keep his family and friends safe, or to run and save himself.

titles.title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
titles.synopsis: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

titles.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
titles.synopsis: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

titles.title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
titles.synopsis: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

titles.title: The Varnell Hill Show
titles.synopsis: Follow Varnell Hill as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.

titles.title: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
titles.synopsis: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

titles.title: The Last Blossom
titles.synopsis: An elderly inmate serving a life sentence awaits a lonely death in solitary—until a voice calls out to him. It belongs to a balsam flower, Housenka, that speaks like a human. Through their 'conversation', the old man reflects on the life he's led.

titles.title: Alien Heart
titles.synopsis: Miles and Ravi house sit a NASA exobiologist mansion, while running astronomy club sign ups, they discover a runaway alien on a ticking cosmic clock, bullies, and crushes that turn their summer into chaos and adventure.

titles.title: NXT Heatwave 2026
titles.synopsis: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

titles.title: Plonternish
titles.synopsis: Eli writes a play.

titles.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
titles.synopsis: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

titles.title: LEATHERBACK
titles.synopsis: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

titles.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
titles.synopsis: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

titles.title: The Salt Path
titles.synopsis: The profound story of husband and wife Raynor and Moth Winn, who embark on a 630-mile trek after being forcibly removed from their home. Hoping that in nature they will find solace and a sense of acceptance, they walk through the beautiful but rugged coastlines of South West England - a journey that is exhilarating, challenging, and liberating in equal measure. THE SALT PATH is a powerful portrayal of home, and how it can be lost and rediscovered in the most unexpected ways.

titles.title: Hi!
titles.synopsis: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

titles.title: Once More
titles.synopsis: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

titles.title: Finding Emily
titles.synopsis: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

titles.title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
titles.synopsis: Upcoming Kannada Film

titles.title: Maya Satya Bhram
titles.synopsis: Two disappearances unsettle Kolkata’s Prafullanagar: Totoro, the young son of Sub-Inspector Sanjay Konar, and Sara Nilson, a Swedish researcher studying shamans. Their fates intertwine around one enigmatic man, Trilokdarshi Baba. Once known as Tilu, a boy haunted by violence and visions of death, Trilok grows into a mystic who seems to perceive the boundaries between the living and the beyond. As Sanjay’s search unfolds, the line between truth and faith begins to dissolve.

titles.title: Colony
titles.synopsis: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

titles.title: The Dog Stars
titles.synopsis: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

titles.title: Filipiñana
titles.synopsis: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

titles.title: Barreda
titles.synopsis: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

titles.title: Beyond Belief
titles.synopsis: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

titles.title: Just Play Dead
titles.synopsis: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

titles.title: The Sun Never Sets
titles.synopsis: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

titles.title: Buddy
titles.synopsis: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

titles.title: Boorman and the Devil
titles.synopsis: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

titles.title: The Last Scene
titles.synopsis: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

titles.title: The Secret Woman
titles.synopsis: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

titles.title: Baggo
titles.synopsis: Directed by Baljit Singh Deo

titles.title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
titles.synopsis: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

titles.title: Slick II
titles.synopsis: Months after escaping the cops, Slick has been doing his best to take care of his family. But when the original owner of the gold chain tracks him down and takes his sister hostage, Slick finds himself on another job to retrieve what has already been stolen.

titles.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
titles.synopsis: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

titles.title: Tom & Cherry
titles.synopsis: When Tom suddenly disappears, a mysterious man named Cheer becomes part of an extraordinary journey that no one sees coming. Packed with laughter, emotions, unexpected twists, and heartwarming moments, Tom and Cherry is a wholesome family entertainer that celebrates the true meaning of love and togetherness.

titles.title: Echo Point
titles.synopsis: A man inherits a secluded cabin from his estranged father. Inside, he discovers an old radio emitting strange, eerie signals. As he begins to unravel the truth, he realises the voices on the other end belong to the victims of a killer.

titles.title: Mahaprabhu Jagannath
titles.synopsis: In Kaliyug, the evil asur Aham traps devotees in a mercury-made world, but their faith in Jagannath never breaks. Guided by young Balram's devotion, Mahaprabhu Jagannath defeats Aham through divine wisdom and frees all, proving that true bhakti always triumphs over ego.

titles.title: Idiots
titles.synopsis: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

titles.title: Legend of the White Dragon
titles.synopsis: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

titles.title: The Producer
titles.synopsis: A reckless young graduate becomes the assistant to a demanding music producer, and their clashes turn into an unlikely partnership as they take on the music industry's biggest challenges.

titles.title: Mousetrap
titles.synopsis: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

titles.title: All the Truth in My Lies
titles.synopsis: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

titles.title: Gang War Oslo
titles.synopsis: An inside look at Norway's criminal landscape since the 1980s -- as told by those who ruled the streets and lived to share their stories.

titles.title: Still Water
titles.synopsis: The small town of Wari Pasop appears peaceful, but beneath the calm exterior hides dark secrets. Years earlier, the unexplained disappearance of a woman set off a chain of events leading to a complex series of murders and a race to uncover a well-buried truth.

titles.title: Part-Timers
titles.synopsis: Two roommates, worlds apart, barely stay together. But these two women share one grand dream: a start-up.

titles.title: The Whisper Man
titles.synopsis: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

titles.title: Dalliance
titles.synopsis: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

titles.title: Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez host a rewatch of films from Marvel Studios' The Infinity Saga, working their way to Avengers: Doomsday. Together, they revisit each film with a recap and a conversation about which themes and characters may continue to have future implications.

titles.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
titles.synopsis: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

titles.title: The Last Sunrise
titles.synopsis: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

titles.title: 2 Big to Rig
titles.synopsis: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

titles.title: Yellow Mirror
titles.synopsis: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

titles.title: The Last Salute
titles.synopsis: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

titles.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
titles.synopsis: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

titles.title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
titles.synopsis: Ever since his mother moved to the city for work, Xiaoqing, who has lost his father, has had a dream: he too wants to go to the Lotus City. After many setbacks, his goal seems out of reach. But when he finds an old, rusty car in the reeds, he finds new hope: will he and his friends make it to the city?

titles.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
titles.synopsis: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

titles.title: The Early Spring
titles.synopsis: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

titles.title: The Airport Chaplain
titles.synopsis: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

titles.title: Totally '90s House
titles.synopsis: Follows two teams of '90s television idols with a passion for design and renovation as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s - think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets - with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

titles.title: Wishbone Kitchen
titles.synopsis: Pull up a kitchen stool and press play. Each week, Meredith Hayden — the voice behind Wishbone Kitchen — sits down to talk cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.

titles.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
titles.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

titles.title: Mom Knows Best?
titles.synopsis: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

titles.title: Plan Bea
titles.synopsis: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.

titles.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
titles.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

titles.title: Stamptown
titles.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

titles.title: Pickleballers
titles.synopsis: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

titles.title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
titles.synopsis: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

titles.title: Spark
titles.synopsis: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop—and soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to its hidden mastermind.

titles.title: Anchorage Point
titles.synopsis: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

titles.title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
titles.synopsis: Follows the story of the groundbreaking Texas-based art-punk band founded by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.

titles.title: Oozhi
titles.synopsis: After two years apart, Lenin and Megha unexpectedly meet at a stargazing camp. When Lenin discovers an alien stone that takes him back into the memories and guilt of their past, he sees a chance to fix what he broke.

titles.title: The Great American Journey
titles.synopsis: The Great American Journey will travel the country celebrating American history and exploring the people, places and ideas that have shaped our nation. The series will examine how the American story continues to evolve and the role each generation plays in defining what comes next.

titles.title: The Marching Band
titles.synopsis: A world-famous orchestra conductor discovers the brother he never knew he had — a school cafeteria worker who plays trombone in a local marching band. Detecting his brother's exceptional musical talent, he takes it upon himself to rectify the injustice of fate.

titles.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
titles.synopsis: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

titles.title: Colours of Time
titles.synopsis: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

titles.title: Mutiny
titles.synopsis: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

titles.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
titles.synopsis: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

titles.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
titles.synopsis: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

titles.title: 7 Dogs
titles.synopsis: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

titles.title: Tony
titles.synopsis: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

titles.title: Spa Weekend
titles.synopsis: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

titles.title: It Ends
titles.synopsis: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

titles.title: Sanjeev
titles.synopsis: Sanjeev, a young aspiring actor from rural Telangana, and debut director Shiva struggle against powerful obstacles, with Sanjeev's financial crisis threatening their shared dream of making a film.

titles.title: All That We Never Were
titles.synopsis: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

titles.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
titles.synopsis: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

titles.title: How to Divorce During the War
titles.synopsis: On the eve of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, a high-flying executive tells her husband she wants a divorce, forcing the couple to navigate their bitter separation amid an escalating mid-life crisis and an unfolding regional refugee emergency.

titles.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
titles.synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

titles.title: Ram and Leela
titles.synopsis: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

titles.title: Facing El Chapo
titles.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

titles.title: Kadhal Aura
titles.synopsis: Two men with opposite beliefs about love and God are cursed to swap souls, forcing them to live each other's lives and face the women they love.

titles.title: Judaa
titles.synopsis: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

titles.title: Modha Rathri
titles.synopsis: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

titles.title: Glimmer
titles.synopsis: After losing a career-defining fashion opportunity, aspiring queer Latinx designer Carlos begins questioning both his talent and his future. Encouraged by his outspoken best friend and inspired by unexpected moments of connection, he discovers the power of ‘glimmers’—small, magical moments of hope that illuminate life’s path. Set against the vibrant backdrop of queer nightlife, fashion, and chosen family, Glimmer is a heartfelt story about resilience, self-worth, and believing in yourself when everything feels uncertain.

titles.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
titles.synopsis: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

titles.title: Harrd Disk
titles.synopsis: Entrusted with a hard disk believed to hold information that could topple ministers, a young boy gets caught in a deadly game between a cop and a political fixer. Everybody wants it. No one knows what's inside.

titles.title: Ameer Log
titles.synopsis: Three carefree friends from a bustling Hyderabad basti spend their days wandering narrow lanes, sharing plates of biryani, and dreaming of a better life. When an old cook's secret recipe brings unexpected success their way, they must choose between fleeting fame and the enduring value of friendship, memories, and the taste of home.

titles.title: The Red Bag
titles.synopsis: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.

titles.title: Bardaasht
titles.synopsis: After being falsely imprisoned, Karma returns to his village determined to take revenge on the man who destroyed his family.

titles.title: Hot Spot
titles.synopsis: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

titles.title: 9/11: Reunited
titles.synopsis: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

titles.title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
titles.synopsis: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

titles.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
titles.synopsis: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

titles.title: He Loves Me Not
titles.synopsis: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.

titles.title: Irumudi
titles.synopsis: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

titles.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
titles.synopsis: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

titles.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
titles.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

titles.title: Kudiyan Shehar Diyan
titles.synopsis: Three ambitious women leave their small towns for the city, chasing successful careers while facing tough choices that threaten their relationships, values, and identities.

titles.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
titles.synopsis: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

titles.title: Blood Sacrifice
titles.synopsis: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

titles.title: S&X
titles.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

titles.title: Outer Banks: The Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Host Ria Ciuffo sits down with Outer Banks stars Chase Stokes, Madelyn Cline, Carlacia Grant, Jonathan Daviss, and Madison Bailey to celebrate the series' five-season run.

titles.title: Abijit Ganguly: Baby
titles.synopsis: Stand-up special

titles.title: Lion
titles.synopsis: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

titles.title: A Beautiful Obsession
titles.synopsis: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

titles.title: Back to the 90s
titles.synopsis: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

titles.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
titles.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

titles.title: Sapan Verma: Lower Back Pain
titles.synopsis: Stand-up comedy special by Span Verma

titles.title: Insecta
titles.synopsis: A celebrated horror novelist returns to an isolated estate to say goodbye to her dying father, only to discover that the monstrous imaginary insect that tormented her childhood may have been real all along.

titles.title: Take a Hike!
titles.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

titles.title: Coyote vs. Acme
titles.synopsis: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

titles.title: Cradle of Coaches
titles.synopsis: This documentary delves into the history of remarkable leaders, their groundbreaking achievements, and the profound connections that have shaped football’s greatest coaching legacy.

titles.title: World's Most Evil Women
titles.synopsis: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities.

titles.title: Disney Worldbuilders
titles.synopsis: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

titles.title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
titles.synopsis: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

titles.title: Wolfsbane
titles.synopsis: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

titles.title: Assembly Required
titles.synopsis: A grieving man receives an unexpected package.

titles.title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
titles.synopsis: From ordinary lives to extraordinary drama. Aspiring contestants fight to earn a spot in the Bigg Boss house.

titles.title: Lanterns
titles.synopsis: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

titles.title: Hushar Pittalu
titles.synopsis: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

titles.title: 108 Base Hospital Uri
titles.synopsis: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

titles.title: Bigg Boss: Agnipareeksha
titles.synopsis: The journey to Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 begins in Agnipareeksha, where commoner contestants battle for a place in the Bigg Boss House.

titles.title: The End of Oak Street
titles.synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

titles.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
titles.synopsis: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah's rivals threaten to destroy everything he's built.

titles.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
titles.synopsis: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

titles.title: The Wrong Girls
titles.synopsis: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

titles.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
titles.synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

titles.title: Late Fame
titles.synopsis: At the very end of the 1970’s, post office worker Ed Saxberger wrote a book of poetry that nobody cared about. After an eager and flattering fan appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of young admirers who anoint him a rediscovered genius. The group of downtown bohemians is led by their “tragic heroine,” Gloria. Intoxicated by the attention, and Gloria’s alluring presence, Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle.

titles.title: The Birthday Party
titles.synopsis: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

titles.title: All Night Wrong
titles.synopsis: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

titles.title: Vishwanath & Sons
titles.synopsis: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

titles.title: Nimrods
titles.synopsis: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

titles.title: Awarapan 2
titles.synopsis: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

titles.title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
titles.synopsis: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

titles.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
titles.synopsis: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

titles.title: Magudam
titles.synopsis: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

titles.title: Madhuramee Jeevitham
titles.synopsis: Madhuramee Jeevitham is a poignant family drama that explores aging, relationships, and the quiet beauty of everyday life.

titles.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
titles.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

titles.title: All Wishes Come True!
titles.synopsis: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

titles.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
titles.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

titles.title: Fast
titles.synopsis: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

titles.title: Elijah Peel
titles.synopsis: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

titles.title: People & Things
titles.synopsis: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

titles.title: Sammarth
titles.synopsis: When an unexpected turn of events shatters a young civil engineer's life, he is forced to confront his past, his beliefs, and his destiny.

titles.title: Aali
titles.synopsis: Mulla (Aali), a sound engineer near the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border, falls for Ebby Mathew, an Ayurveda doctor working in Dubai. Facing family opposition and pressure to accept other matches, she plans to elope with him. Whether he returns in time, and whether their plan succeeds, forms the story's core.

titles.title: Pallaburusu
titles.synopsis: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

titles.title: The Brink of War
titles.synopsis: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

titles.title: The Rotten Files with Stephanie Soo
titles.synopsis: Stephanie Soo dives deep into today's most explosive cases to uncover killers and predators who thought their stories would stay buried.

titles.title: The Sex Slave
titles.synopsis: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner.

titles.title: Batwara 1947
titles.synopsis: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

titles.title: Od Or
titles.synopsis: Documentary about the Bene Israeli Jewish community of Pune.

titles.title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
titles.synopsis: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

titles.title: The Last Assassins
titles.synopsis: After her father is murdered, a young warrior known as “The Kid” and her guardian cross a violent dystopian future in search of the aunt she has never met. The world is trapped in permanent winter and shrouded in deadly fog, and Nobel is bound by an oath to protect the few remaining members of her family. Their journey leads them to an abandoned laboratory, where holograms reveal secrets from the family’s past. But as the boundary between the digital and physical worlds begins to collapse, the young woman may hold the key to what comes next.

titles.title: Inferno
titles.synopsis: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

titles.title: Redux entity
titles.synopsis: Arjun, a young cab driver, is winding down after a long night shift when he accepts one more ride request. What starts as a routine late-night fare quickly turns strange — the pickup location doesn’t match what he expects, and things escalate from there into something eerie and increasingly out of his control

titles.title: Detective Teekshanaa
titles.synopsis: Every husband has detective wife. A proper detective role has become super at every stage.

titles.title: Olmo
titles.synopsis: When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her, embarking on a night of laughs and chaos.

titles.title: The Fence
titles.synopsis: Horn is welcoming his partner Léone into the hut he shares with Cal, when a man called Alboury appears. He stays there until they return the body of his brother, who was killed on the site.

titles.title: 120 Bahadur
titles.synopsis: Valiant Indian soldiers fight against Chinese troops during the 1962 Sino-Indian War, preventing a potential occupation of Ladakh region in the Battle of Rezang La.

titles.title: Ayogya 2
titles.synopsis: Follows Siddhegowda as he navigates the challenges and responsibilities of public life after becoming a Gram Panchayat member.

titles.title: ChaO
titles.synopsis: In a futuristic world where humans and mermaids coexist, the life of mild-mannered office worker Stephan is upended when he is suddenly proposed to by Chao — a princess from the mermaid kingdom. With no time to make sense of what's happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao, and her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers.

titles.title: Korean Kanakaraju
titles.synopsis: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

titles.title: One Night Only
titles.synopsis: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

titles.title: KJQ
titles.synopsis: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

titles.title: Ice Cream Man
titles.synopsis: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

titles.title: DC
titles.synopsis: Rebel Devadas  joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stake in their fight.

titles.title: G.D.N
titles.synopsis: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

titles.title: Do Us Part
titles.synopsis: When Rose—Ryan’s college best friend and unrequited love—crashes his wedding with a change of heart, years of buried emotions threaten to shatter his world. As Ryan reels, his best man must navigate a minefield of secrets to get his friend to "I do" before the past rewrites the future.

titles.title: Thudakkam
titles.synopsis: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

titles.title: Cookie Queens
titles.synopsis: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

titles.title: A Child of My Own
titles.synopsis: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

titles.title: The Great Punjab Robbery
titles.synopsis: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.

titles.title: THE RIBBON HERO
titles.synopsis: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

titles.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
titles.synopsis: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

titles.title: Ohh My Dog
titles.synopsis: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

titles.title: Vivaah
titles.synopsis: Vivaah revolves around four married couples as they navigate the chaotic challenges of modern relationships. From unexpected restrictions and arranged marriages to a wife's romantic longings amid a workaholic husband's neglect, the narrative follows four women fighting unique emotional battles in search of fulfilment and understanding.

titles.title: Get Set Go
titles.synopsis: A wild adventure where one pedal stroke could change everything.

titles.title: Photographer
titles.synopsis: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

titles.title: Amader 7 Kahon
titles.synopsis: A SSR Cinemas Pvt Ltd production.

titles.title: Picture
titles.synopsis: Picture is an upcoming Kannada romantic comedy-drama that celebrates dreams, love, and family relationships with a wholesome entertainer.

titles.title: Awake
titles.synopsis: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

titles.title: Yamudu
titles.synopsis: Yamudu follows Lord Yama's descent to earth to unleash brutal Garuda Purana punishments on the guilty. A police investigation and intertwining fates build toward a shocking revelation about who Yama truly is and the trauma behind his wrath.

titles.title: The Seasoning
titles.synopsis: One man's lunch plans go suddenly awry. Were his cooking skills up to par?

titles.title: Super Troopers 3
titles.synopsis: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

titles.title: Deep6
titles.synopsis: An extraordinary story of an ordinary woman Mitul, who strives to change things which appear fossilized.

titles.title: Our Sticky Love
titles.synopsis: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

titles.title: Falcons
titles.synopsis: Andy is trained by his ex-hitman father to infiltrate Hell's Cartel, but when his sister is kidnapped and betrayal hits, the plan unravels, sparking the H-Game, turning child violence into global control.

titles.title: National Seating
titles.synopsis: Pleas Everson Sr. waxes poetically about his history of employment.

titles.title: Potato Salad
titles.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

titles.title: Solace
titles.synopsis: Framed by a speech given by the filmmaker’s brother at their uncle’s memorial service, this doc/fiction hybrid comedy blends archival family photos with surreal animated scripted scenes to explore outsized childhood fears, shifting family dynamics and intergenerational care.

titles.title: Devils Lake
titles.synopsis: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

titles.title: Ottamaram
titles.synopsis: It revolves around an elderly couple—Ravi and Bharathi—who have been living separately to cater to the needs and commitments of their children.

titles.title: The Lift
titles.synopsis: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

titles.title: Holy Father
titles.synopsis: A horror thriller from the makers of 'Holy Ghost'

titles.title: Oriental Hardon
titles.synopsis: Explores the “no Asians” ban through "gaysian nude archives."

titles.title: coool
titles.synopsis: an elsie fisher joint

titles.title: I Want Your Sex
titles.synopsis: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

titles.title: The Gentleman Thief
titles.synopsis: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

titles.title: Analogue Natives
titles.synopsis: This experimental documentary circulates around interviews with four veterans who worked all their lives in analogue (=celluloid) film laboratories and animation studios in Mumbai, and who all lost their businesses and jobs around 2012–14, when the Hindi film industry went through a drastic shift to digital production. They reflect on the loss of their craftsmanship, but also on the philosophies of their handmade film practice versus readymade digital solutions. While the film drifts into various related and unrelated scenarios, shot on the streets of Mumbai, we learn about the art of living and working under precarious conditions in India and survival strategies in one of the most crowded and commercial cities in the world. Finally everything results in a futile collage of nostalgia and memories, mashed up with the absurd aesthetics of AI slop.  An expanded multi-genre documentary within the constraints of the so-called Masala Formula, popularly known from Indian cinema.

titles.title: Unmadham
titles.synopsis: A police constable reopens a long-forgotten case and experiences an unsettling world.

titles.title: Sheep in the Box
titles.synopsis: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

titles.title: Vestige
titles.synopsis: When a hooded figure steps into an abandoned house deep in the woods, flickering lights awaken memories of the family who once called it home.

titles.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
titles.synopsis: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

titles.title: Stay in the car
titles.synopsis: Set against the dim glow of streetlights and the hum of passing sirens, Stay in the Car captures one night in the life of a fifteen-year-old girl waiting in her mother's El Camino and the quiet reckoning that unfolds in the stillness. Based on real events, Stay in the Car explores the fragile line between safety and survival, love and neglect. It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.

titles.title: HANDMEDOWN
titles.synopsis: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

titles.title: Maaran
titles.synopsis: In a patriarchal society, two strangers - Birwa, a trafficking survivor, and Tara, who faces the same fate - are drawn into the path of a ruthless predator. Maaran exposes the devastating impact of gender-based violence and oppression.

titles.title: Tadviruddha
titles.synopsis: When a woman mysteriously disappears from a secluded coffee estate, suspicion falls on those closest to her. As a determined detective digs deeper, long-hidden secrets unravel in this psychological mystery.

titles.title: Newton's 3rd Law
titles.synopsis: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

titles.title: Karmakhya
titles.synopsis: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

titles.title: Mamachya Govyala Jauya
titles.synopsis: Three friends win a free Goa trip and invite an old college buddy who brings a surprise guest. Their dream vacation turns into chaos as plans unravel. The unexpected companion becomes both the trip's highlight and its downfall.

titles.title: Jolly
titles.synopsis: In an age where love and marriages crumble over broken trust, Jolly and Jaanu build theirs on the one thing missing everywhere else — complete faith in each other.

titles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
titles.synopsis: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

titles.title: The Truthers
titles.synopsis: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

titles.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
titles.synopsis: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

titles.title: Jana Nayagan
titles.synopsis: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

titles.title: Elite Force
titles.synopsis: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

titles.title: Idhayam Murali
titles.synopsis: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

titles.title: Ikka
titles.synopsis: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

titles.title: Alpha
titles.synopsis: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

titles.title: 23 000 Lives
titles.synopsis: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

titles.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
titles.synopsis: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

titles.title: Welcome To The Jungle
titles.synopsis: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

titles.title: Cocktail 2
titles.synopsis: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

titles.title: Maa Inti Bangaram
titles.synopsis: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

titles.title: The Death of Robin Hood
titles.synopsis: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

titles.title: Husbands in Action
titles.synopsis: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

titles.title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
titles.synopsis: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

titles.title: Mollywood Times
titles.synopsis: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

titles.title: The Marked Woman
titles.synopsis: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

titles.title: Parimala and Co
titles.synopsis: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

titles.title: Teach You a Lesson
titles.synopsis: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

titles.title: Maa Behen
titles.synopsis: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.

titles.title: Peddi
titles.synopsis: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

titles.title: Scary Movie
titles.synopsis: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

titles.title: Masters of the Universe
titles.synopsis: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

titles.title: Blast
titles.synopsis: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

titles.title: Backrooms
titles.synopsis: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

titles.title: Mexico 86
titles.synopsis: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

titles.title: Drishyam 3
titles.synopsis: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

titles.title: Kartavya
titles.synopsis: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

titles.title: The WONDERfools
titles.synopsis: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

titles.title: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
titles.synopsis: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

titles.title: Kattalan
titles.synopsis: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

titles.title: Karuppu
titles.synopsis: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

titles.title: Athiradi
titles.synopsis: Energetic student Samkutty revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

titles.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
titles.synopsis: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

titles.title: Dridam
titles.synopsis: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

titles.title: Desire
titles.synopsis: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

titles.title: Swapped
titles.synopsis: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.

titles.title: Patriot
titles.synopsis: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

titles.title: Kara
titles.synopsis: A thief tries to go straight, but when predatory banks trap his father in debt, he returns to crime — with a determined cop closing in on his trail.

titles.title: Michael
titles.synopsis: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

titles.title: Bhooth Bangla
titles.synopsis: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there, but strange supernatural events and panicked locals force him to investigate the property's mysterious past.

titles.title: Toaster
titles.synopsis: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

titles.title: Love Insurance Kompany
titles.synopsis: In 2040, an app premised on ensuring romance for all is used widely by the population. When the voice behind the app's AI realizes its misconception to true love, he embarks on a quest to prove that love does not come from a screen.

titles.title: Bharathanatyam 2 Mohiniyattam
titles.synopsis: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime. Forced into a desperate cover-up to protect their future, the family must navigate a treacherous path of secrecy and mounting pressure, determined to overcome any obstacle by any means necessary.

titles.title: Boulevard
titles.synopsis: Hasley, a girl with a list of unfulfilled dreams, and Luke, a complex and vulnerable boy marked by a tragic past, find refuge on the boulevard where they discover if love can conquer all.

titles.title: Perfect Crown
titles.synopsis: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

titles.title: Raakaasa
titles.synopsis: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

titles.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
titles.synopsis: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

titles.title: Eat Pray Bark
titles.synopsis: Five eccentric dog owners seek help in dealing with their four-legged friends. Their last hope: an intensive course with the charismatic and legendary dog trainer Nodon in the Tyrolean mountains.

titles.title: Bonolota Express
titles.synopsis: On a foggy winter journey, the Bonolota Express carries strangers burdened by secrets whose lives begin to collide within the train’s confined corridors. As the night unfolds, personal and political crises erupt, exposing hidden grief, moral decay, and moments of unexpected compassion amid chaos and revolt. By dawn, the train moves on, leaving its passengers irrevocably changed by a single journey where illusions collapse and human truths emerge.

titles.title: Agent Zeta
titles.synopsis: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.

titles.title: Youth
titles.synopsis: Youth follows Praveen, a 15-year-old boy who enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. As he goes through multiple relationships and heartbreaks, he slowly begins to understand what love truly means. Along the way, the experiences shape his growth, maturity, and outlook on life.

titles.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
titles.synopsis: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

titles.title: Project Hail Mary
titles.synopsis: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

titles.title: Made in Korea
titles.synopsis: A woman from a small town in Tamil Nadu moves to South Korea — a place she always dreamed of — but struggles to find her footing in a foreign land.

titles.title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
titles.synopsis: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

titles.title: Hoppers
titles.synopsis: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

titles.title: Accused
titles.synopsis: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels. Now under a storm of suspicion and scrutiny, her marriage fractures and the truth blurs. Her wife must decide whether to walk away, or fight for the woman the world is turning against.

titles.title: Vengeance
